page_title: LEV 1-2 DOR | Bayer Leverkusen v Dortmund 29/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.

90+5' A cross by Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Dortmund.
90+4' This is a yellow card! Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
90+4' Claudio Echeverri (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
90+3' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area. Corner kick. Bayer Leverkusen will have an opportunity.
90+3' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a long cross over to Christian Michel Kofane, but Gregor Kobel comes forward to gather the ball.
90+1' Jarell Quansah (Bayer Leverkusen) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
90+1' Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
90+1' Niko Kovac has decided to substitute Julian Brandt and he is replaced by Carney Chukwuemeka (Dortmund).
90+1' Niko Kovac is forced to make a change. Felix Nmecha is unable to continue due to injury, Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) comes on.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 8:3.
89' Claudio Echeverri (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the corner with a short pass.

89' So close! Claudio Echeverri (Bayer Leverkusen) delivers a cross into the box, it almost finds the head of one of his teammates, but one of the defenders is quickest to the ball and coolly deals with the threat. The referee blows his whistle, Bayer Leverkusen are awarded a corner kick.
88' Kasper Hjulmand has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) replacing Ernest Poku.
88' Robert Andrich goes off the pitch and Jarell Quansah (Bayer Leverkusen) comes on.
88' Yan Couto (Dortmund) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
88' A clumsy foul by Yan Couto (Dortmund) and Tobias Welz blows his whistle. It's a free kick to Bayer Leverkusen in a dangerous position.
86' Bayer Leverkusen seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

83' 1 - 2 It's a goal! Christian Michel Kofane (Bayer Leverkusen) shows off his superb ability as he volleys the ball from inside the box into the bottom right corner. The assist goes to Ibrahim Maza and the score changes to 1:2.
82' Fabio Silva (Dortmund) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.

81' Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. Dortmund win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
81' Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Gregor Kobel, who smothers the ball.
80' Niko Kovac has decided to make a change. Jobe Bellingham (Dortmund) replaces Karim Adeyemi.
80' Julian Ryerson will be replaced by Yan Couto (Dortmund).

78' What a great touch by Ernest Poku (Bayer Leverkusen)! He picks up a precise pass inside the box and immediately produces a shot towards the net. Unfortunately for him, his bullet only crashes against the crossbar.

75' A pass travels right across the box to Julian Brandt (Dortmund) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper low in the middle of the goal, but Mark Flekken denies him with a decent save.
75' A pass from Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) is intercepted by Mark Flekken and the move breaks down.
74' Kasper Hjulmand prepares a substitution. Jonas Hofmann is replaced by Claudio Echeverri (Bayer Leverkusen).
74' Here comes a substitution. Martin Terrier (Bayer Leverkusen) is brought on as a substitute for Malik Tillman.

73' What a poor attempt! Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes into the stands.
72' CHANCE! Julian Brandt (Dortmund) fires just wide of the right post from inside the box after running onto a splendid pass from Felix Nmecha.
71' What an opportunity! Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) disappointed the fans as he smashed a first-time shot from inside the box against the crossbar!
70' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) takes it short.
69' A pass into the penalty area from Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) is intercepted by the defence. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Bayer Leverkusen.
69' Ernest Poku (Bayer Leverkusen) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
68' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
67' 9:5 – the total goal attempt statistics. The number of shots on goal at present is 3:3.
65' 0 - 2 Goal! A nice lofted pass into the box by Fabio Silva is pounced on by Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund). His close-range header flashes past Mark Flekken and into the right of the goal. 0:2.

64' A cross following the corner kick finds its way to Loic Bade (Bayer Leverkusen) inside the box and he manages to steer it to the bottom left corner. He is about to start celebrating a goal, but Gregor Kobel makes a save in the nick of time to maintain the current score.
64' Corner kick. Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) is ready to send the ball into the box.

63' Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety. The ball goes out of play. Bayer Leverkusen are awarded a corner kick.
63' Here is a change. Patrik Schick is going off and Kasper Hjulmand gives the last tactical orders to Christian Michel Kofane (Bayer Leverkusen).
62' Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) plays a terrific long ball forward to Daniel Svensson, but he can't beat his man and the move breaks down.
61' We are about to witness a subsitution. Fabio Silva (Dortmund) for Serhou Guirassy.

59' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) creates himself some space inside the goalmouth and connects with the free kick. His accurate header would have probably ended up in the roof of the net, but Mark Flekken pulls off a superb reflex save to thwart him.
59' Referee Tobias Welz sees the trip by Malik Tillman (Bayer Leverkusen) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. It's a free kick to Dortmund, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
57' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.

57' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) attempted to send a defence-splitting pass into space where Patrik Schick was lurking. It could have put him one-on-one with the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players somehow manages to avert the threat.

56' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the roof of the net. Gregor Kobel displays brilliant reflexes and pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
56' Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
55' Aleix Garcia floats over the free kick into a crowded box. Malik Tillman (Bayer Leverkusen) does well to win the ball, but sends his header just wide of the right post from close in.
54' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
54' Bayer Leverkusen players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
53' The ball is cleared after Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
52' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
51' Tobias Welz blows his whistle after Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. There is a free kick near the sideline to Bayer Leverkusen.
50' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
49' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Bayer Leverkusen have been awarded a corner kick.
47' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen).
46' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.

45' Ernest Poku (Bayer Leverkusen) collects a simple pass and decides to shoot from distance. It's a swerving effort aimed towards the roof of the net, but Gregor Kobel reads it well and makes a comfortable save.
44' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Serhou Guirassy, but he can't get on the end of the pass.

41' 0 - 1 Perfectly executed free kick. Daniel Svensson floats the ball in and Aaron Anselmino (Dortmund) leaps high to connect with it near the penalty spot. His bullet header flicks off the post into the left side of the goal. The score is now 0:1.
40' The referee is firm and issues Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) a deserved yellow card.
40' Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) commits a rough challenge and Tobias Welz blows his whistle for an infringement. Free kick. Dortmund will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
38' Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) is first to react to a great cross from Alejandro Grimaldo, but slices his shot well wide of the left post from inside the box.
38' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen).
38' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
37' Ernest Poku (Bayer Leverkusen) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Bayer Leverkusen.
36' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
35' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

34' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Bayer Leverkusen.
33' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The linesman points to the corner flag, Bayer Leverkusen are going to take it.

33' A through ball from Malik Tillman (Bayer Leverkusen) fails to reach Ernest Poku as one of the defending players reacts brilliantly to intercept the effort. If the pass had been produced a little bit earlier, Ernest Poku could have got into a promising position.
31' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 2:2. 0:0 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
30' Malik Tillman (Bayer Leverkusen) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
29' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) whips in a cross from the corner, but Mark Flekken is well positioned and punches the ball away.
29' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Dortmund.
28' Dortmund keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
26' Tobias Welz interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Felix Nmecha (Dortmund).
24' Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
23' The game is interrupted now, Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
22' Chance! Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) comes within inches of scoring after picking up a pass from Malik Tillman, but his shot from inside the box flashes inches wide of the left post.
22' That looked a certain handball by Loic Bade (Bayer Leverkusen) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
21' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

20' Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) plays a long ball to Daniel Svensson, but the defence is well organised and manages to get it clear. The ball goes out for a corner. Dortmund can continue in their attacking effort.
17' Ernest Poku (Bayer Leverkusen) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
17' The ball possession is 56:44.
16' Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) whips the ball into the box and Karim Adeyemi takes a perfect touch to control it, but one of the defenders does well to intercept.
15' An attempted cross from Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) is cleared.
14' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) plays a lovely through ball to Patrik Schick, but he can't beat Gregor Kobel and loses the ball.
13' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the left post.
11' Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
10' Ernest Poku (Bayer Leverkusen) amazingly found his way through the defence, but lacked a precise finish as his effort from close range went slightly over the crossbar.
8' Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) sent a pass onto Daniel Svensson, who didn't get a chance to finish.
7' Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) commits a foul during an attacking move.
7' Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) picks out Julian Brandt with a fine lofted pass, but the latter wasn't able to create some space to get into shooting range.
6' The Dortmund players are exchanging some short passes.
4' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
3' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) launches a cross from the corner, but Mark Flekken is alert to thwart the effort.
2' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The referee signals a corner kick to Dortmund.
2' The Bayer Leverkusen players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Dortmund will take the kick-off.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
Tobias Welz was nominated as the referee for this game.
